get.description:
Retrieves a list of all channels with optional filtering and pagination.

Filters:
- is_favorited: Show only favorited channels
- folder_id: Show only channels in a specific folder (use 0 for channels with no folder)
- tag_id: Show only channels with a specific tag

Pagination:
- limit: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 200)
- offset: Number of items to skip

parameters.name: folder_id

schema.description: Filter by folder ID (use 0 for root/no folder)
schema.title: Folder Id

parameters.description: Filter by folder ID (use 0 for root/no folder)

post.description:
Creates a new YouTube channel in the application.
- Fetches channel details from the YouTube Data API.
- Stores the channel information in the database.

delete.description:
Deletes ALL channels from the database.
This is a destructive operation intended for testing.

Requires confirmation parameter: ?confirm=DELETE_ALL_CHANNELS

parameters.name: confirm

schema.description: Must be exactly 'DELETE_ALL_CHANNELS' to confirm this destructive operation
schema.title: Confirm

parameters.description: Must be exactly 'DELETE_ALL_CHANNELS' to confirm this destructive operation

get.description:
List videos with optional filtering and search.

Filters:
- is_favorited: Show only favorited videos
- is_watched: Show only watched/unwatched videos
- is_short: Show only YouTube Shorts or exclude them
- channel_id: Filter by single channel ID or multiple IDs (comma-separated)
- tag_id: Show only videos with a specific tag
- published_after: Show videos published after a date (e.g., "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")
- published_before: Show videos published before a date (e.g., "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z")
- q: Full-text search across video title, description, and tag names
- order_by: Sort field (default: published_at; use "relevance" with search queries)
- order_direction: Sort direction (asc or desc)
